title: Zingy Shredded Thai Chicken, Carrot & Red Cabbage Salad
description: Poached and shredded chicken thigh tossed with shredded red cabbage, grated carrot and mint, dressed with a spicy lime and fish sauce dressing.
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken thigh fillets, excess fat trimmed
large handful of mint leaves (~15g), roughly chopped
Dressing: 1 red chilli (deseeded, finely chopped), 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp honey, ½ tsp salt, juice of 2 limes
steps: Fry chicken thighs in cooking spray for 2 minutes each side; cover with boiling water and soy sauce; lid on; simmer gently 10 minutes.
Remove chicken; shred immediately using 2 forks.
Put cabbage, carrots and mint in a large bowl; place shredded chicken on top.
Mix all dressing ingredients; pour over salad; toss to combine.
notes: Great for using up leftover roast chicken. Replace chicken with grilled halloumi for a vegetarian version. A food processor with grating attachment speeds up prep.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
